related.title: 太陽星與托帕茲光電廠
related.titleEn: Solar Star and Topaz Solar Farms
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「驅動馬達的功率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；太陽星與托帕茲光電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "Power of the drive motor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Solar Star and Topaz Solar Farms must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦讓整排模組跟著太陽轉：追日增益、回溯避影、風扭矩、馬達功率與角度誤差；太陽星與托帕茲光電廠則以兩座 550 MW 級電廠的對照：薄膜與晶矽、固定與追日、模組數量與容量因數為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on turning whole rows to follow the sun: tracking gain, backtracking, wind torque, motor power and angle error; Solar Star and Topaz Solar Farms centres on two 550 MW-class plants compared: thin film and crystalline silicon, fixed and tracking, module count and capacity factor, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「陰影長度與回溯」的模型移到太陽星與托帕茲光電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「追日支架的容量因數」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Shadow length and backtracking" to Solar Star and Topaz Solar Farms, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Capacity factor with trackers", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「驅動馬達的功率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；太陽星與托帕茲光電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "Power of the drive motor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Solar Star and Topaz Solar Farms must be respecified.

related.title: 光伏逆變器最大功率追蹤
related.titleEn: Photovoltaic Inverter Maximum Power Point Tracking
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「驅動馬達的功率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；光伏逆變器最大功率追蹤的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "Power of the drive motor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Photovoltaic Inverter Maximum Power Point Tracking must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦讓整排模組跟著太陽轉：追日增益、回溯避影、風扭矩、馬達功率與角度誤差；光伏逆變器最大功率追蹤則以隨時找到功率最大的那一點：擾動觀察、加權效率、部分遮蔭、散熱與電壓範圍為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on turning whole rows to follow the sun: tracking gain, backtracking, wind torque, motor power and angle error; Photovoltaic Inverter Maximum Power Point Tracking centres on finding the point of maximum power at every moment: perturb and observe, weighted efficiency, partial shading, cooling and voltage window, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「陰影長度與回溯」的模型移到光伏逆變器最大功率追蹤，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「逆變器的散熱」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "I–V curve and fill factor".
Move the model of "Shadow length and backtracking" to Photovoltaic Inverter Maximum Power Point Tracking, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Inverter cooling", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「驅動馬達的功率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；光伏逆變器最大功率追蹤的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "Power of the drive motor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Photovoltaic Inverter Maximum Power Point Tracking must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 太陽能追日機構與控制
history.text: 2017 年維亞努埃瓦電廠開工；2018 年電廠全部併網；2019 年多起強風損壞促使業界研究扭轉顫振。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2017: Construction of Villanueva began. 2018: The plant was fully connected. 2019: Wind damage at several plants prompted study of torsional galloping. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
